SocialPilot is a generic social media scheduling tool. Starting at $25.50/month on the annual Essentials plan, you get a post scheduler, a content calendar and AI-generated captions; analytics start on Standard ($42.50) and bulk upload on Premium ($85). But you still create every graphic, edit every video and manage everything yourself; AI Pilot only drafts the captions.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
